tools.name: get_quote
tools.title: Get quote
tools.description: Latest price and daily change for a Yahoo-style ticker (e.g. AAPL, ENI.MI, ASML.AS). Public market data — no auth required.

symbol.description: Yahoo-style ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, ENI.MI

tools.name: search_strategies
tools.title: Search strategies
tools.description: Search Vela's strategy library by free-text query (name, category, risk, horizon). Public — no auth required.

tools.name: get_watchlist
tools.title: Get watchlist
tools.description: Return the signed-in Vela user's watchlist items (symbol, name, added-at).

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.title: Get portfolio
tools.description: Return the signed-in Vela user's portfolio holdings (symbol, shares, avg price, currency).

tools.name: get_net_worth
tools.title: Get net worth summary
tools.description: Return the signed-in Vela user's net-worth accounts with totals for assets, liabilities and net. Values are in each account's stored currency (no FX conversion).

tools.name: list_cash_flow
tools.title: List cash flow entries
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's cash flow entries (income/expense), most recent first. Optional `limit` (default 100, max 500).

limit.description: Max entries to return (default 100, capped at 500).

tools.name: add_cash_flow_entry
tools.title: Add cash flow entry
tools.description: Record an income or expense for the signed-in user. Use `recurring_monthly: true` for fixed monthly bills or salary — Vela will project it forward automatically.

direction.description: Whether this is income or an expense.

category.description: Category label (e.g. Salary, Housing, Food, Subscriptions).

amount.description: Positive amount in the entry's currency.

entry_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today when omitted.

recurring_monthly.description: True if this repeats every month.

tools.name: project_dividends
tools.title: Project future dividend income
tools.description: Model annual dividend income for a given horizon using contributions, dividend yield, dividend growth, price appreciation, tax rate and optional DRIP. Accepts an optional `positions` array to seed the starting value and blended yield from real holdings. Returns per-year rows (portfolio value, gross/net dividends, yield on cost) plus totals.

starting_value.description: Starting portfolio value in the projection currency.

monthly_contribution.description: Monthly cash added to the portfolio.

contribution_growth_pct.description: Annual growth of monthly contributions in percent.

dividend_yield_pct.description: Starting annual dividend yield in percent.

dividend_growth_pct.description: Annual dividend growth rate in percent (DGR).

tax_pct.description: Dividend withholding/income tax rate in percent.

reinvest.description: If true, net dividends buy new shares (DRIP).

reinvest_rate_pct.description: Optional global DRIP rate 0-100 overriding `reinvest`. Ignored if any position sets `drip_pct`.

positions.description: Optional real holdings. When provided, seed the starting value and blended yield from these positions.

tools.name: run_backtest
tools.title: Run backtest
tools.description: Run a fast historical backtest on a Yahoo-style ticker with a preset strategy (buy_hold, sma_cross, rsi). Returns CAGR, total return, max drawdown, Sharpe, hit rate, and trade count. Requires authentication (rate-limited).

symbol.description: Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, ENI.MI, BTC-USD

tools.name: start_run
tools.title: Start a backtest or sensitivity run
tools.description: Kick off a `backtest` (single-config) or `sensitivity` (parameter sweep) simulation and return a run_id. Follow up with `get_run_status`, `get_run_result`, or `get_run_logs`. Requires authentication.

input.description: For kind='backtest': BacktestInput { symbol, preset, range, initial_capital, fast, slow, rsi_period, rsi_buy, rsi_sell, stop_pct, target_pct }. For kind='sensitivity': BacktestInput + `sweep` object with arrays of values for fast/slow/rsi_period/rsi_buy/rsi_sell (max 64 combinations).

tools.name: get_run_status
tools.title: Get run status
tools.description: Return progress and status of a simulation run created with `start_run` (kind, status, progress 0-100, started/finished/canceled timestamps, error string if failed). On error returns a typed envelope `{ error: { code, message } }` with codes: not_authenticated, not_found, db_error. Requires authentication; only the run owner can read it.

tools.name: get_run_result
tools.title: Get run result
tools.description: Return the full result JSON of a completed simulation run. Errors with a typed envelope `{ error: { code, message, status?, progress? } }` when the run is not ready. Codes: not_authenticated, not_found, db_error, run_running, run_failed, run_canceled. Requires authentication; only the run owner can read it.

tools.name: get_run_logs
tools.title: Get run worker logs
tools.description: Return the worker log timeline (info/warn/error) and any error string for a simulation run. Useful for debugging failed runs. On error returns a typed envelope `{ error: { code, message } }` with codes: not_authenticated, not_found, db_error. Requires authentication; only the run owner can read it.

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.title: Cancel a simulation run
tools.description: Request cancellation of an in-flight backtest or sensitivity run started with `start_run`. Sets `cancel_requested=true` on the run; the worker checks the flag between iterations and stops cleanly, writing `status='canceled'`. If the run is already `succeeded`, `failed`, or `canceled`, the call is a no-op. Requires authentication; only the run owner can cancel.

tools.name: watchlist_updates
tools.title: Poll watchlist updates
tools.description: Reliable polling for agents. Returns (1) latest quotes for every symbol on the signed-in user's watchlist, (2) dividend fields (yield / rate / ex-date), and (3) alerts fired since the `since` cursor. Pagination: pass the returned `next_since` as `since` on the next call. `has_more=true` means more alerts exist beyond `limit` — page again with the same `since` until `has_more=false`, then advance to `next_since`. Requires authentication.

since.description: ISO timestamp cursor from a prior `next_since`. Only alerts strictly after this are returned. Omit for last 24h.

limit.description: Max alerts per page. `has_more` indicates more pages.

include_quotes.description: Skip quote fetches for pure alert-tail polling (faster).

tools.name: list_tool_docs
tools.title: List tool documentation
tools.description: Return documentation of every tool this MCP server exposes. `format='markdown'` (default): human-readable catalog with inputs, outputs, auth, rate limits, and error codes. `format='json'`: the same catalog as structured data. `format='json-schema'`: the full machine-readable MCP manifest (JSON Schema per tool) so an external agent can auto-generate a typed client. Public — no auth required.
